name: torn-paper-rip
description: A fibrous paper tear runs across the frame: the torn sheet shows its white paper core along the edge and lifts away on a soft shadow, leaving the next scene standing.

vars.description: Which way the tear travels across the frame.
Color of the exposed paper cross-section riding the tear.
How jagged and fibrous the tear edge is. Low is a clean deckle edge, high is roughly torn.
